## Owner decision — 2026-11-26
R03 passed targeted independent review (A1–A6); owner authorized FR-000 through FR-006. Owner subsequently selected the public repository `feralenterprises/Project-Raccoon`, superseding the private-destination assumption. Public source development is authorized; Plugin Hub submission, public product identity, and cutover remain separate decisions. Do not modify Burrow.

## Operating protocol — 2026-11-26 (owner-authorized, effective immediately)
Purpose: faster safe development, no reduction in acceptance standards. This section governs workflow only; R03, architecture, authorization boundaries, required evidence and existing stop conditions remain controlling. No new code, merge, publication, native test, or adoption authorization follows from this protocol.

- **Permanent regression:** Every confirmed defect receives a durable automated regression covering the observed failure and relevant boundary, in the appropriate maintained test suite. Link defect/reproduction to test identifier and fix SHA; demonstrate red on faulty baseline (or equivalent controlled reproduction) and green on repair; keep it running in routine CI. Deduplicate by behavior, not test count. If automation is genuinely infeasible, keep defect/gate open or blocked with explicit reason and seek owner-approved disposition; manual evidence is not a silent substitute. Apply to all newly confirmed defects and reconcile outstanding confirmed defects as part of current repairs/FR-005, not a separate interruption.
- **Risk-based review:** CRITICAL/HIGH: account identity/scope, lifecycle, observers, data isolation, cancellation/concurrency, architecture/contracts, privacy, release/packaging, dependency or rights boundaries, production integration and any change affecting a required gate. Independent reviewer checks source/diff, negative/adversarial cases, relevant exact-SHA evidence and required artifacts. NORMAL: bounded functionality; independent targeted diff and relevant tests, plus standard CI. LOW: isolated copy/layout/cosmetic or documentation-only changes with no contract, privacy, behavior, build or gate effect; lightweight targeted review and appropriate checks. Escalate uncertain or mixed changes; no self-acceptance of critical work. Never waive existing required independent, native, artifact or owner receipts because a change is labeled low risk.
- **Compact handback:** SHA/ref (local-only explicitly identified) + issue/checkpoint | results (test IDs/counts, CI/artifact link and required digest/size when applicable) | blockers/risks | next assignment and dependency. Link existing evidence instead of copying logs or repeating research. Mandatory R03 evidence remains mandatory; distinguish reported, independently verified, and owner/native accepted.
- **Single authority:** This issue #1 is the authoritative cross-workstream status and dispatch record. #4/#5 and draft PR #3 carry detailed evidence/implementation records, not competing gate decisions. Solis is the designated status/dispatch writer; agents submit evidence in their existing workstream or handback, not overwrite the master table. Before dispatch or update, refresh #1 and the relevant head/assignment; include expected predecessor SHA and gate state. If stale, conflicting or changed, stop only the conflicting write/dispatch, reconcile with current evidence, and preserve history. No agent advances a dependent gate from chat alone. Current summary/table governs; older audit entries are historical. Do not start duplicate tickets or independent status ledgers. Acknowledge protocol at next normal handback; do not interrupt active assignments.
- **Parallel execution:** One execution owner per change/lane; separate workspaces/branches, no overlapping edits without coordinator assignment. Claude 1 continues isolated UI prototype/native-host replica review under existing limits, with central scope contract re-pin only after independent acceptance; no production mount or native owner test authorization. Claude 2 continues the current bounded foundation repair (FR-002 reopened/FR-003 hold); no FR-004 before both gates pass. Feral retains authorized isolated research #4 then #5 after capacity returns; no research execution assumed and no production integration. Solis coordinates and independently reviews. Unblocked authorized work may proceed in parallel; never cross dependency, rights, native or owner approval gates. No extra sessions assumed.
- **Usage conservation:** Check existing pinned research, fixtures, prior results and CI artifacts before repeating work. Reuse evidence where source, inputs, environment and claim match; rerun affected checks when changed, stale or required by a gate. Run standard mandatory suites as required, not duplicate manual/independent full runs for low-risk changes. Batch related checks, use small targeted repair diffs, and document only decision, evidence, blockers and next action. Independent exact-candidate verification and final four-receipt requirements are preserved. No speculative work or repeated owner smoke tests.
- **Automatic gate reopening (procedural):** A verified defect invalidating an accepted checkpoint immediately changes its current status to REOPENED/HOLD, records affected SHA/contract and regression, and blocks dependent acceptance/advancement. Preserve earlier receipt as historical, not current proof. Coordinator reconciles affected lanes; unrelated authorized work continues. Repair and independently re-accept affected gate on appropriate exact candidate with retained regressions; then explicitly re-evaluate dependent gates. Missing evidence = BLOCKED; reproduced failure = FAIL/HOLD. CI green never overrides a known failing independent case. No automated bot or branch protection change is implied.
- **Initial application:** FR-002 REOPENED (P1 foreign-scope authority collision reproduced at `fa6749c9` and `b31d0f7d`); FR-003 HOLD (remaining scope isolation and bank subscriber cancellation). Existing Claude 2 repair remains assigned; require permanent foreign-instance and cancellation regressions, preserve 30/30 bank replay, targeted independent re-review of both gates. FR-004–006 remain pending. UI-003/004 artifact review remains BLOCKED; research #4/#5 unchanged. No code or branch change made by this governance update.

## Usability review aid — Feral audit (2026-11-26 Pacific)
Coordinator reviewed Feral's research against [owner ledger #302](https://github.com/feralenterprises/Burrow/issues/302), [design contract #356](https://github.com/feralenterprises/Burrow/issues/356), [native failure #323](https://github.com/feralenterprises/Burrow/issues/323), [Pathfinder #187](https://github.com/feralenterprises/Burrow/issues/187) and the current integration contract. Accepted as a compact review aid for existing sequential panel approvals; not a new checkpoint, code assignment, native acceptance or authorization. Existing R03 and owner decisions govern.
- Targets, not measured receipts or rigid caps: primary destination, Settings, Back and Pathfinder Full Map from Pathfinder 1 click; common preferences 2, advanced 2–3; no extra plugin click for supported automatic bank capture/activity detection. Count actual interactions from stated starting state, including menu/expand/confirm and required scrolling separately; justify exceptions. Two-second first glance remains owner rule (location, state/freshness, next action); beginner discoverability needs human evidence, not an invented score.
- Reusable panel review: (1) clear primary action and purpose, compact defaults and on-demand detail; (2) one navigation authority, Back and Settings fixed together at the top-right (see owner navigation clarification below), no duplicate rail/header, verify fallback when rail absent; (3) click paths, keyboard/focus, no needless input or confirmation, meaningful contextual links only; (4) independent local selections/filter/scroll and separate window return context, reset/rebind account-specific state and reject stale queued callbacks; (5) truthful shared intelligence and evidence states, no competing cache/calculator; (6) actual supported viewport/scaling, readable text, no clipping/horizontal overflow, continuous full-height background, shared R02 asset/component provenance, no decorative clutter; (7) preserve verified behavior, regression-test confirmed defects and retest affected earlier panels when common components change.
- Keep Home opportunity-first, snapshot bottom; no generic Quick Access/crew/tip duplication. Outfitter no unnecessary step labels; Pathfinder compact route plus separate resizable full branching map focused on next unfinished action; explicit contextual navigation only. Settings Option 1 two tabs Interface and Combat & Tracking, shared settings authority; routine reversible changes direct/immediate where safe, retain necessary destructive/safety confirmations. Preserve current Tools functionality pending owner usage; GIM deferred. Other panel suggestions are review hypotheses, not feature deletions or new scope.
- Record in existing panel receipt: panel/reference and asset revision, top 2–3 applicable journeys with start/clicks/scroll/exception, checklist PASS/FAIL/BLOCKED/N/A with links to existing screenshot/test evidence, owner decisions. Reuse common shell checks unless affected; use risk-based review and no separate audit reports. Prototype checks are provisional; native receipts and owner approval unchanged.
- Open: UI-003/004 archives unavailable for this review, host rail/242 vs 268 geometry and supported scaling unverified; do not change widths or adopt a duplicate header. Basic/Full content differences, exact advanced settings grouping, Tools redundancy and beginner task timings require later review. No objective acceptance based on Feral's subjective ratings. No production changes, new gates, merges, branch changes or interruptions to current assignments.

One work branch and draft PR, seven logical checkpoints. Keep main stable. First buildable commit: release 11, ordinary classes major ≤55, architecture direction, clean build and artifact-content/size checks. FR-001 must pass before FR-002; missing inputs/artifact = BLOCKED, actual failure = FAIL. Foundation post-processed JAR ≤256 KiB; no bypass of official checks. Final acceptance requires all required cases and four distinct receipts on the same final source SHA. No production UI, network calls, account persistence, game writes, extra runtime dependencies, personal account records, secrets, unapproved assets, or broad legacy host imports. No public Hub submission or feature expansion in this authorization.

R03 is the governing handoff; retain it separately from public source until its contents are explicitly cleared for publication. FR-007–018 reserved. FR-019 slice ledger and subsequent milestones require foundation acceptance and new authorization.

Every handback: exact source SHA, artifact or explicit blocker, commands/results, next assignment. CI pass is not native acceptance. Owner approves final promotion.
